blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines— A restobar brawl in Barangay Poblacion 3, Carcar City turned violent on Sunday, November 8, leaving a 25-year-old college student wounded and leading to the arrest of a 29-year-old man. Police identified the suspect as alias “John,” 29, a married and unemployed resident of Sitio Lagang, Barangay Ocaña, Carcar City. The victim, identified as alias “Josh,” 25, is a fourth-year university student from Barangay Poblacion, Sibonga.
